events.description: CIA information report disseminated on incorporation of Zawahiri's al-Jihad Organization into Bin Ladin's al-Qa'ida, citing a shortage of funds and dependence on Bin Ladin's financial assistance.
CIA information report disseminated to DIA, NSA, FBI and other agencies. It assesses that al-Jihad has in practice been incorporated into al-Qa'ida because of its financial dependence on Bin Ladin.
De facto incorporation of Zawahiri's al-Jihad Organization into Bin Ladin's al-Qa'ida, driven by financial dependence.

key_claims: Zawahiri's al-Jihad Organization faced a shortage of funds as of September 1998.
Zawahiri increasingly relied on financial assistance from Usama Bin Ladin.
This dependence resulted, for practical purposes, in al-Jihad's incorporation into al-Qa'ida.
